I need to find the characteristic polynomial of the given matrix, which is det(A - λI).

Given matrix:
$$A = \begin{pmatrix} -4 & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10 & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14 \end{pmatrix}$$

First, I'll form A - λI:
$$A - \lambda I = \begin{pmatrix} -4-\lambda & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10-\lambda & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14-\lambda \end{pmatrix}$$

Now I need to calculate the determinant of this 3×3 matrix. I'll expand along the first row:

$$\det(A - \lambda I) = (-4-\lambda) \begin{vmatrix} 10-\lambda & 4 \\ -5 & -14-\lambda \end{vmatrix} - (-13) \begin{vmatrix} -9 & 4 \\ 12 & -14-\lambda \end{vmatrix} + 10 \begin{vmatrix} -9 & 10-\lambda \\ 12 & -5 \end{vmatrix}$$

Let me calculate each 2×2 determinant:

For the first determinant:
$$\begin{vmatrix} 10-\lambda & 4 \\ -5 & -14-\lambda \end{vmatrix} = (10-\lambda)(-14-\lambda) - (4)(-5) = (10-\lambda)(-14-\lambda) + 20$$
$$= -140 - 10\lambda + 14\lambda + \lambda^2 + 20 = \lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120$$

For the second determinant:
$$\begin{vmatrix} -9 & 4 \\ 12 & -14-\lambda \end{vmatrix} = (-9)(-14-\lambda) - (4)(12) = 126 + 9\lambda - 48 = 78 + 9\lambda$$

For the third determinant:
$$\begin{vmatrix} -9 & 10-\lambda \\ 12 & -5 \end{vmatrix} = (-9)(-5) - (10-\lambda)(12) = 45 - 120 + 12\lambda = -75 + 12\lambda$$

Now substituting back:
$$\det(A - \lambda I) = (-4-\lambda)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) + 13(78 + 9\lambda) + 10(-75 + 12\lambda)$$

Let me expand each term:

First term: $(-4-\lambda)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120)$
$$= -4(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) - \lambda(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120)$$
$$= -4\lambda^2 - 16\lambda + 480 - \lambda^3 - 4\lambda^2 + 120\lambda$$
$$= -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 104\lambda + 480$$

Second term: $13(78 + 9\lambda) = 1014 + 117\lambda$

Third term: $10(-75 + 12\lambda) = -750 + 120\lambda$

Combining all terms:
$$\det(A - \lambda I) = -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 104\lambda + 480 + 1014 + 117\lambda - 750 + 120\lambda$$
$$= -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + (104 + 117 + 120)\lambda + (480 + 1014 - 750)$$
$$= -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 341\lambda + 744$$

Therefore, the characteristic polynomial is:
$$\boxed{-\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 341\lambda + 744}$$
